verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is for outbound outreach: Lorikeet says campaign cadences with scheduling windows control when outreach happens. That is a narrow, campaign-specific form of recurring timed execution. Nothing documents general scheduling of recurring jobs or workflows, such as cron-like triggers or scheduled simulation batches, via the UI or MCP. Missing for 10: general-purpose recurring job/workflow scheduling, schedule management via MCP or API, detailed docs on cadence configuration, independent corroboration.
